name: Syslog-ng
description: Syslog-ng is a flexible, highly scalable syslog server that collects logs from all your network devices. It supports both BSD (RFC3164) and IETF (RFC5424) syslog formats, making it compatible with virtually any router, switch, access point, or server.
short_desc: Centralized syslog server with real-time web UI
author: syslog-ng team

form_fields.label: Container User (UID:GID)
form_fields.hint: Process user and group ID (UID:GID). Keep 1000:1000 unless custom host permissions are required.
form_fields.pattern_error: Must be a numeric UID:GID (e.g. 1000:1000) or numeric UID (e.g. 1000)
